name: qBittorrent
tagline: BitTorrent client with a web UI
description: Full-featured torrent client with web interface, RSS support, categories and a built-in search plugin system.
compose:
services:
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8080"
      - "${{cfg.torrent_port}}:6881/tcp"
      - "${{cfg.torrent_port}}:6881/udp"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "UTC"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
      - /downloads:/downloads
    restart: unless-stopped
